name: Teddy
hero_lede: This week I finished three concrete things, retired one belief I used to hold, and found one pattern worth checking rather than declaring.

consequences.title: Three polite declines to shop-tour requests, ready to review.
consequences.body: Two tourists and one food blogger. Each reply preserves the relationship while closing the door.
consequences.because: You have repeatedly protected affinage days from interruptions.

consequences.title: Four European cheese competitions, down from twenty-nine.
consequences.body: Anything colliding with Tuesday deliveries or centered on networking was removed.
consequences.because: Tuesday delivery work has stayed non-negotiable across the selected conversations.

consequences.title: Cousin Martin's farm invitation became a twenty-minute call.
consequences.body: The visit remains open without consuming the only protected day off.
consequences.because: You asked for a smaller commitment after rescheduling the visit four times.

decisions.title: Newsletter growth is not the current objective.
decisions.body: The working strategy is a smaller, more attentive readership rather than broad acquisition.

open_tasks.title: Choose whether to enter one shortlisted competition.
open_tasks.body: The shortlist is ready; the remaining decision is whether any entry deserves the time.

observations.title: Your deeper cheese essays are not an accidental exception.
observations.body: The preference for short writing did not hold when you reviewed the pieces you were proudest of.
observations.evidence: You asked to keep the writing approachable, then spent three revisions protecting the technical detail in the Vacherin draft.
observations.provenance: Apr 10 · Vacherin draft thread · six consistent signals

observations.title: You may prefer critics who are blunt enough to be useful.
observations.body: The pattern appears across three conversations, but it may be specific to cheese criticism.
observations.evidence: You rejected 'a journey' and kept the reviewer you described as 'grumpy and correct.'

retired.old_belief: Teddy wants to grow the newsletter.
retired.why: That was wrong. The better model is curated, opinionated, small: fewer readers, more attention, no growth-hack suggestions.

gap.stated_count: Said three times in the selected window.
gap.revealed: Protected depth and technical detail through repeated revisions.

becoming.title: From hobbyist newsletter to working critic
becoming.body: Questions about credentials, judging, and category definitions are appearing more often. The direction is visible, but it is not yet a conclusion.

question: Are the World Cheese Awards a direction you want to pursue, or only a possibility you want to keep available?
